name: DisCorkie
blurb: DisCorkie lets you browse, join, and manage multiple forums in one easy-to-use app.
description:
DisCorkie lets you browse, join, and manage multiple forums in one easy-to-use app. Whether you're active in several communities or looking for new discussions, DisCorkie makes it simple to stay connected.

No need to keep multiple tabs open—DisCorkie brings all your Discourse communities together. Switch between forums effortlessly, track conversations, and stay updated without distractions.

Looking for discussions that match your interests? DisCorkie allows you to search and explore forums with ease, helping you discover new communities to engage with.

DisCorkie is available on Linux, with mobile versions for Android and iOS in development. Stay connected across all your devices.

• Manage multiple Discourse forums in one app

• Discover and join new communities

• Enjoy a distraction-free browsing experience

• Stay connected to your forums wherever you are

Download DisCorkie and keep your favorite forums within reach.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
